primary_task: Run Hugging Face ML models in JavaScript/Node via Transformers.js pipelines (classification, generation, ASR, etc.).

requirements.name: node
requirements.evidence: Requires Node.js 18+ ... server-side runtimes (Node.js, Bun, Deno)

requirements.name: huggingface.co
requirements.evidence: using pre-trained models from Hugging Face Hub ... Internet access is needed for downloading models from Hugging Face Hub; pipeline('sentiment-analysis') downloads default model

requirements.name: HF_TOKEN
requirements.evidence: Optional: custom fetch for auth headers ... Bearer ${HF_TOKEN}

requirements.name: gpu/WebGPU
requirements.check: no nvidia-smi; container has no GPU

notes: Local-models mode is mentioned as optional ('optional if using local models') but every primary example loads models from the Hub; no local models exist here. Model files also served from HF CDN/xet hosts (cdn-lfs.huggingface.co, cas-bridge.xethub.hf.co), both also refused (403).
